newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's bike-riding basher strikes again.
newsitem.headline: Japan's bike-riding basher strikes again.

text.p: Police on Monday warned young women to be on the lookout for a bicycle-riding attacker who has bashed about 40 women in the face while riding past them.
The warning was issued after a new attack on Saturday in which a 22-year-old woman riding a bicycle was bashed in the face with a small baseball bat.
A police spokesman said the attack was linked to about 40 similar attacks in Tokyo and the neighbouring city of Saitama since last October.
Japanese media have dubbed the attacker the "Phantom Basher".

"This is a very unusual crime -- hitting young women in the face with bats, concrete blocks or even stones. It shows that he has a very big grudge. We can only conclude that he is mentally disturbed," the spokesman told Reuters.
"In many cases the woman attacked is riding a bike when she's hit in the face so the possibility of a fall or a heavy blow leading to death cannot be ruled out if the attacks continue," he added.
A witness to Saturday's attack said a man in his twenties riding a bicycle lashed out with a 40 cm (15 inch) long baseball bat as he passed the woman from the opposite direction.
The victim was in hospital with a serious gash to her forehead, the police spokesman said.
He said the attacks usually happened in deserted streets in the late afternoon or evening when women were either walking or cycling alone.
